title: A billable invoice still sends the portal's new invoice email
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a portal contact for this test for customer A, whose mailbox the tester can read.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Complete, billable.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Create invoice.
  3. Open the contact's mailbox.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The invoice is created.

Step 3:

  • The portal's new invoice email for work order 1 has arrived.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
